meta.title: Chimera — The Bitcoin Super-App
meta.description: Chimera Wallet is the first Bitcoin super-app. Non-custodial, browser-based, no install required. Your keys, your control.

hero.heroLeftAlt: Chimera wallet app showing balance and transactions
hero.title: THE ONLY BITCOIN SUPER-APP BUILT SO NOBODY CAN EVER TAKE YOUR MONEY AWAY.
hero.subtitle: Not a promise. Not a policy. Mathematics.
hero.tagline:
Mainchain. Lightning. Arkade Protocol. One app.

Your keys. Nobody in between.

control.title: CONTROL
control.body: Your keys. Your coins. Full stop. Bitcoin mainchain, Lightning, Arkade Protocol VTXO - the complete Bitcoin stack, non-custodial from the first second to the last.

trade.title: TRADE
trade.body: Non-custodial safety. Buy, sell, and swap with zero spread markup - without ever sending funds to someone else's wallet. Support for Fiat and many other assets. No KYC under 1K CHF per month*. Non-custodial Chimera swaps coming soon.

earn.title: EARN
earn.body: Refer friends and earn a share of platform fees - up to 20%, no cap, no expiry. Not points. Real revenue. P2P loans.

superchargingBitcoin.title: SUPERCHARGING BITCOIN
superchargingBitcoin.subtitle: Three layers. One interface. Zero compromise.

mainchain.title: MAINCHAIN
mainchain.body: Full BTC on-chain deposits and withdrawals and Fiat on/off ramp via third party providers.

arkadeProtocol.title: ARKADE PROTOCOL
arkadeProtocol.body: VTXO technology: mainchain-grade security, Lightning-grade speed without the channel headaches. Chimera is the first Super App on Arkade Protocol.

lightning.title: LIGHTNING
lightning.body: Full Lightning invoice support, enhanced by Boltz. Every merchant, every exchange, zero channel management.

selfCustody.title: SELF-CUSTODY
selfCustody.subtitle: DOESN'T STOP AT THE CHECKOUT.
selfCustody.body: Zero monthly fee. Zero top-up fee. 1.5% transaction fee locked for life. First 1,000 pre-orders only.

cextToken.title: CEXT TOKEN
cextToken.subtitle: The more you hold, the harder the platform works for you.
cextToken.body: 1 Billion fixed supply. Fee discounts up to 50%. Referral multipliers up to 3×. Governance at Diamond tier. Zero inflation. Classified as a utility token under the Swiss regulation.

referrals.title: REFERRALS
referrals.subtitle: Share once. Earn on every trade they make. Forever.
referrals.body: Up to 20% of platform fees. No cap. No expiry. Revenue share, not points.
referrals.disclaimer: * Referral rewards apply to users who complete KYC verification.
